outcome.answer: The closest matches are papers on regional-language social media and dialect variation in Bengali and Tulu [2, 4, 6, 7, 8]. [2] and [7] analyze Bengali or Tulu social media comments for classification tasks, while [4] studies place-linked language variation in social media communities. [6] focuses on regional dialect identification in Bangla text, and [8] shows that code-switched social-media data can be sparse and challenging for language models.
